title: Isandro and the Vector
author: Theo Blackwood
blurb: Silas Crane, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
